title: output_webhook
description: POSTs each pipeline event as JSON to an HTTP(S) webhook URL.

url.description: Webhook URL that receives the POSTs; nothing is sent when empty.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout for each POST in milliseconds.

auth_header.description: Full extra header line added to each request, for example "Authorization: Bearer X".

event_types.description: Event types to forward; empty forwards every event.
